results.title: Psychology says people who never cry in front of anybody but can't hold onto tears when they are alone at times aren't as emotionally strong as they appear: What the behavior reveals?
results.description: Psychology says people who never cry in front of anybody but can't hold onto tears when they are alone may be managing emotions in different ways depending on their surroundings. Public emotional control can come from fear of judgment, concern for others, past experiences or learned coping habits. Crying in private can provide a space where a person feels safe enough to process stress and emotion.

results.title: Badminton-India's world championships organisers hire monkey whisperers
results.description: Monkey mimics will be employed to deter primates at the upcoming badminton World Championships in New Delhi. Organizers are using langur monkey sounds to keep rhesus monkeys away from the venue. Pigeons also posed a problem, leading to court fouling during a previous event. A non-toxic gel has been applied to stadium areas to prevent birds from roosting. Organizers state that all issues faced previously have now been addressed.

results.title: SC agrees to Tamil Nadu govt plea to hear Cauvery water dispute early
results.description: Appearing before Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, senior advocate CS Vaidyanathan, for Tamil Nadu, highlighted the deficit in allocation of the river water has left farmers in a perilous situation.
